## Eval scorecard

<!-- State the measurement aim, headline assessment and coverage. Provide computed
counts AND percentages: NO_ISSUE_FOUND / DEFECT / UNRESOLVED / NOT_ASSESSED. Separate
question validity from grading accuracy and model performance. Distinguish main
problems, subproblems and submissions. Link evidence for every headline number.
Use GL components where available, backed by an accessible table. No invented grade. -->

## Eval datasheet

<!-- Authors, intended domain and measurement, source/dataset revisions, architecture:
prompt -> model/scaffold -> environment -> submission -> grader -> aggregation.
Explain what is fixed versus variable between runs. -->

## Audit setup

<!-- Corpus, deduplication, model configurations, pilot and full audit jobs, sample
coverage, exclusions, expenditure and verification. Mark prepared by as automated;
human verification and approval are pending. Never copy names from the template. -->

## Audit findings

### A. Construct validity
<!-- Does performance measure the intended capability? Confounds, proxy, contamination. -->

### B. Content validity
<!-- Domain coverage and representativeness; do not infer from item correctness. -->

### C. Task specification
<!-- Wrong gold, impossible/ambiguous tasks, missing information, hidden requirements. -->

### D. Scaffolding
<!-- Prompt, agent loop, memory, feedback/retries and coaching. -->

### E. Harness
<!-- Tool calls, termination, context/message handling, state and implementation bugs. -->

### F. Environment
<!-- Tools, resources, dependencies, non-determinism, leakage and implementation drift. -->

### G. Grading
<!-- False accepts/rejects, criteria, judge errors, representation sensitivity,
partial credit and exploitation. Confirm candidate correctness before relabelling. -->

### H. Resource limits
<!-- Token/time limits, sensitivity and unequal constraints; distinguish timeout
from proof the code would pass with more time. -->

### I. Informativeness
<!-- Saturation, floors/ceilings, clustering and uncertainty; comparable runs only. -->

## Scoring criteria and limitations

<!-- For each dimension: None / Minor / Major / Critical / Not assessed / Not applicable.
A clean item label means no issue found under specified completed checks.
Separate established score corrections from hypotheses. List unresolved checks
and reproducible next experiments; link question-level evidence and source logs. -->
